parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: End time. Default is the current time.

parameters.name: Fields
parameters.description:
Type of performance statistics to query. Separate multiple types with commas.

- InstanceCapacityEachType: Total capacity share for each dataset acceleration instance type.

- InstanceNumEachType: Number of instances for each dataset acceleration instance type.

- SlotNumEachType: Number of slots for each dataset acceleration slot type.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: Start time. Default is one hour before the current time.
